new_findings.description: This uncommitted diff adds the FR-FLOW-023/024/028 feature text (research-doc A/B verify loop, requirement-gathering research, github-issue research entry) to all three agent variants. In claude/codex the fanout wording is correct — those variants have NO single-worker constraint (grep: skills/claude|codex/kiwi-srs 'multi-worker fanout 금지|single-worker 토폴로지|한 번에 하나만' = 0). But the etc variant is a local-LLM profile whose hard SSOT forbids exactly this: kiwi-srs §0.20 (L45) '**multi-worker fanout 은 금지되며, 위임 worker/evaluator 는 한 번에 하나만 사용한다**' + header L8 'disables multi-worker fanout, uses one delegated worker/evaluator at a time'; kiwi-srs-research §0.5 (L35) '**single-worker 토폴로지 고정**' + L16 'single-worker 고정 토폴로지'. The three added lines were copied verbatim from claude/codex (byte-identical to skills/claude/kiwi-srs L353 / L572 and skills/codex mirror) WITHOUT adapting the topology to the etc single-worker profile, so etc/kiwi-srs now says '리서치 서브에이전트 3개를 병렬 투입' / '(문서 수 × 3)개 ... 병렬로 팬아웃' and etc/kiwi-srs-research says '5-서브에이전트 토폴로지에 투입' — each a direct same-document contradiction of the same skill's §0.20/§0.5 that a reader/agent cannot reconcile, and one with behavioral-misdirection risk (an agent following §5.4/§9.6 literally would spawn 3× parallel workers on a local LLM that the profile exists precisely to prevent). It also violates the etc migration invariant: skills/etc/MIGRATION_PLAN.md L91's verification grep explicitly enumerates '병렬', 'parallel', 'multi-subagent', '5-서브에이전트' as forbidden tokens that must NOT appear in skills/etc — the etc forbidden-token sweep now returns exactly these 3 diff-introduced hits (all other 병렬/fanout mentions in skills/etc are legitimate negations: 'fanout is disabled', 'not in parallel', '문서별로 순차'). Same defect class the fix chain treated as must-fix for stale labels (QB-208), but here a functional topology contradiction, not just a label. Not seen by Axis A r6 or Axis B r6 (both scoped to the model-label hygiene of hot-fix/review-fix-loop/kiwi-coder, not the FR-FLOW-023/024/028 etc-adaptation).
new_findings.suggested_fix: Adapt the three added lines to the etc single-worker profile (same edit pattern the etc migration already applies elsewhere, e.g. extended-workflow.md 'multi-doc 비-max: 문서별로 순차(sequential, per document)'): (a) etc/kiwi-srs §5.4 L352 → '요구사항 수집 리서치 서브에이전트를 순차(sequential)로 투입' (drop '3개를 병렬', or '한 번에 하나씩 순차 위임'); (b) extended-workflow.md §9.6 L148/L150 → replace the '--max 3개 병렬' / '(문서 수 × 3) 병렬 팬아웃' bullets with the etc single-worker equivalent (sequential per-document, one delegated worker at a time, honoring §0.20); (c) etc/kiwi-srs-research L168 → '5-서브에이전트 토폴로지' → 'single-worker 토폴로지' (matching §0.5/L16). new_findings.description: The mini-removal replaced the old etc §10.4 'Evaluator A/B/C | local-LLM max-profile | local evaluator' table with the claude/codex SSOT prose '단일 검증 서브에이전트 ... 현재 세션 모델(current session model) ... --model <name> override' (git-diff-introduced L246/L250/L251). Two mismatches vs the fix chain's stated etc treatment (fix_round6: etc keeps local-LLM profile terminology, 'genericize 트리거 미해당'): (1) the '--model <name>' option is referenced but NOT defined anywhere in etc/kiwi-srs (grep: '--model' appears ONLY in this §10.4 block, absent from etc/kiwi-srs §1.2 options — the etc migration removed --mini/--squirrel and defaults to --max with no --model control per MIGRATION_PLAN L68), so §10.4 documents an option the etc variant does not expose; (2) the phrasing '현재 세션 모델' departs from the etc variant's own vocabulary ('local-LLM max-profile' / 'local evaluator', which L13 says already map to the current host/session model), leaving etc/kiwi-srs internally split between §0.20/body (local-LLM terms) and §10.4 (claude/codex terms). Lower severity than QB-209 and NOT a behavioral contradiction: the §10.4 topology COUNT (단일 + 독립 2차 순차 검증 패스) is sequential and thus still consistent with the etc single-worker profile, and '현재 세션 모델' is conceptually defensible via L13. Purely a terminology/option-reference leak, cosmetic; disclosed for completeness, not a gate blocker on its own.
